d: Chestnut brown hair is cut into a short bob with blunt bangs, held back by a white headband. The amber eyes are large and wide with a surprised expression, set in a youthful, adolescent face. The build is slender, dressed in a white sleeveless sailor-style top with a brown collar, a red pleated skirt, and white knee-high socks. A grey mechanical weapon is held in both hands, with a brown strap crossing the torso.
